title: Autoregressive Physics-Informed Neural Operator Surrogates and Joint 4-D Seismic-Production Bayesian History Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.31677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a surrogate-accelerated Bayesian history-matching framework, demonstrated on a realistic synthetic model ($N=100{,}188$ cells). The forward map $\mathcal{G}$ is replaced by a Fourier neural operator $\mathcal{G}_\theta$ trained in a closed loop, $\hat{x}_{n+1}=\mathcal{G}_\theta(u,\hat{x}_n)$, with the discrete black-oil residual $R(x_{n+1},x_n)$ as a physics-informed neural operator (PINO) penalty, truncated backpropagation and noise injection. translated_title: 自回归物理信息神经算子代理模型与四维地震-生产数据联合贝叶斯历史拟合
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种由代理模型加速的贝叶斯历史拟合框架，并在一个真实感的合成模型（N=100,188个网格单元）上进行了验证。该框架将正演映射 G 替换为在闭环中训练的傅里叶神经算子 G_θ，即 x̂_{n+1} = G_θ(u, x̂_n)，并以离散黑油方程残差 R(x_{n+1}, x_n) 作为物理信息神经算子（PINO）惩罚项，同时采用截断反向传播与噪声注入技术。我们利用自适应正则化集合卡尔曼反演（aREKI）同化生产数据与四维地震数据，并通过代理模型的闭式 Gassmann 变换在滚动预测过程中合成 ΔV_p，采用两阶段调度方案（先对生产数据执行 aREKI，再对两类数据同时使用多数据同化集合平滑器 ES-MDA）。为缓解问题的病态性，我们并非在 R^{2N} 中直接反演 (log K, φ)，因为当 N_e << 2N 时会导致协方差矩阵秩亏并产生零空间……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以自回归物理信息傅里叶神经算子作为代理模型加速的贝叶斯历史拟合框架，通过两阶段 aREKI 与 ES-MDA 策略联合同化生产数据与四维地震数据，显著降低了大规模油藏反演的计算成本与病态性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a surrogate-accelerated Bayesian history-matching framework based on autoregressive physics-informed Fourier neural operators, which jointly assimilates production and 4-D seismic data via a two-stage aREKI and ES-MDA scheme, substantially reducing the computational cost and ill-posedness of large-scale reservoir inversion.
